title: "Data collection month"

editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console

Dans ce document, on ouvre les données d'OR pour voir à quel mois ont été réalisées les enquêtes

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(haven)

# Define the range of years
years <- 1995:2015
path <- "data/ROS_MDG_microdata/"
# Initialize an empty data frame to store all the data
all_data <- tibble()

# Loop through each year to read the data
for (year in years) {
  # Define the file path
  file_path <- paste0(path, year, "/res_deb.dta")
  
  # Read the data file
  data <- read_dta(file_path) %>%
    # Select the required columns and add the year
    select(j0, j14_b) %>%
    mutate(year = year)
  
  # Append the data to the all_data data frame
  all_data <- bind_rows(all_data, data)
}

# Convert the observatory code to integer
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(j0 = as.integer(j0))

# Read the observatory names
observatory_names <- read_excel("data/observatory_names.xlsx")

# Convert the code to integer
observatory_names <- observatory_names %>%
  mutate(code = as.integer(code))

# Merge the data with observatory names
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(observatory_names, by = c("j0" = "code")) %>%
  group_by(j0, name, year, j14_b) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  filter(j0 %in% c(3, 4, 21, 24, 71))

# Plot the data using ggplot2
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = as.integer(j14_b), y = year, color = name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Year", color = "Observatory") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 12, by = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_minimal()
```
